title: The Vermilion Mask Anime First Main Trailer and Voice Cast Revealed
content: The upcoming dark fantasy anime The Vermilion Mask has revealed its first main trailer along with the main Japanese voice cast. The anime was previously confirmed as a two-part series, set to premiere in October 2026.

title: Gacha Girls Corps Anime Unveils New Trailer
content: Gacha Girls Corps anime unveiled a new trailer on Saturday as part of Crunchyroll’s anime showcase at Anime Expo 2026. It is slated to premiere in January 2027. Takashi Asami is directing the anime at studios Zero-G and Saber Works.

title: 1st Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Anime Film to Stream on Crunchyroll on July 28
content: Crunchyroll announced at Anime Expo on Friday that it will stream Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai , the first film in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy , on its service starting on July 28 worldwide outside of Japan and Mainland China.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Unanswered Butterfly Anime Reveals 19-Minute Preview Available Until July 6
content: The new Sword Art Online anime Unanswered//butterfly anime revealed a 19-minute preview, which will be deleted on July 5 at 23:59 PDT. The anime was made for the Sword Art Online: Echoes of Aincrad game, which is set in the universe of Sword Art Online and will launch globally on July 10 .
author: Anime Corner

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Premieres January 2027
content: The previously announced Season 2 of Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms will premiere in January 2027. Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The first season premiered in January 2025 with 12 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime Reveals 1st Main Trailer, Cast
content: The staff for the anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga revealed the first main trailer with English subtitles during Crunchyroll 's Anime Expo panel on Friday. The staff also revealed the cast.
author: ANN

title: Dengeki Daisy Reveals Main Cast in Teaser Trailer
content: The previously announced Dengeki Daisy anime adaptation revealed the main cast in a teaser trailer released on Saturday. The voice cast includes: • Yoshino Aoyama as Teru Kurebayashi • Taku Yashiro as Tasuku Kurosaki Sota Ueno ( Days with My Stepsister ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN.
author: Anime Corner
